L185: # Free remote MCP servers (tested weekly)
L186: 
L187: Remote 【82†Model Context Protocol†modelcontextprotocol.io】 servers from the 【83†official MCP Registry†registry.modelcontextprotocol.io】 that answer without any API key, token or login. Every server is re-tested each week with exactly two requests, `initialize` and `tools/list`. No tool is ever called.
L188: 
L189: Last run: 2026-10-26 · 20,778 endpoints tested · 11,903 open (57 %) · 6,529 need auth · 2,346 not working · 9,631 listed after removing copies
L190:   * Tool annotations (as declared by the servers, not verified): 3,640 of 11,894 open servers annotate none of their tools. Of 136,731 tools, 99,727 carry annotations, 76,849 say readOnlyHint true, 7,670 say destructiveHint true. Per server in the `tools_annotated`, `tools_read_only` and `tools_destructive` columns. Note: we only see the tools a server lists without a key.
L191:   * Full list: 【84†`data/servers.csv`】 and 【85†`data/servers.json`】
L192:   * Browse with search and topics: 【56†shortformkit.com/free-remote-mcp-servers†shortformkit.com】
L193:   * Check any server yourself: 【86†MCP Server Tester†shortformkit.com】
L194:   * Analysis with charts (failure reasons, hosting, tool counts): 【87†State of remote MCP servers 2026†shortformkit.com】
L195:   * Key numbers with dates, ready to cite: 【88†MCP statistics 2026†shortformkit.com】
L196: ## Add a server to your client
L197: 
L198: Client  | How
L199: --- | ---
L200: Claude (claude.ai, desktop)  | Customize, Connectors, + Add, Add custom connector, paste the URL
L201: Claude Code  | `claude mcp add --transport http NAME URL`
L202: Cursor  | `{"mcpServers": {"NAME": {"url": "URL"}}}` in `~/.cursor/mcp.json`
L203: VS Code  | `{"servers": {"NAME": {"type": "http", "url": "URL"}}}` in `.vscode/mcp.json`
L204: ## Is your server in the list?
L205: 
L206: Show its live status in your README. The badge re-tests the endpoint about once an hour (same two read-only requests) and links to the full test result:
L207: 
L208:     [![MCP status](https://shortformkit.com/api/mcp-badge?url=YOUR_URL_ENCODED)](https://shortformkit.com/mcp-server-tester/?url=YOUR_URL_ENCODED)
L209: 
L210: Replace `YOUR_URL_ENCODED` with your endpoint, URL-encoded, or run the 【86†MCP Server Tester†shortformkit.com】 once and copy the ready-made badge from the result.
L211: ## Picks by topic
L212: 
L213: Up to 25 per topic: one per publisher, 3 to 40 tools, servers with a website or repo first, fastest first. Open means usable without signing up, not an endorsement: read what a server does before you connect it.
